summary: All checks pass (build, vet, test, secrets). The Revision replaces hardcoded refs/heads/master with dynamic primary-ref resolution from git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD, with an optional forest.yaml primary override, and exports FOREST_PRIMARY_REF into Run environments. Changes trace through Runner worktree preparation, Auditor evidence snapshots, and verdict publish fast-forward; primary.go adds validation and remote HEAD symref parsing with fail-closed refusal. Tests cover remote resolution, config override, invalid refs, audit, and publish. No blocking correctness, security, or maintainability findings.
